item.title: Show HN: Sqnc.run – a live cipher stream inspired by number stations
item.summary: I built a tool to broadcast cipher sequences over a shared public stream. anyone can transmit. the output is visible to everyone, but understanding it is another matter, only those who know what they're watching will be able to make sense of it. inspired by number stations.
